basics.label: Frontend Engineer - Interactive & 3D
basics.summary: Frontend Engineer with 5 years of experience, specializing in interactive 2D and 3D web visualizations. I build product configurators in Three.js and PixiJS for the furniture, construction and industrial sectors, from parametric geometry and real-time material changes to 2D editors, AR and render export. A solid React and TypeScript foundation (Next.js, Mantine) and backend experience (NestJS) let me connect visualizations to real data, pricing and ordering. I care about performance, smooth interactions and UX.

work.summary: I build interactive web applications in React and Next.js (TypeScript), focused on 2D and 3D product configurators for clients in the furniture, construction and industrial sectors. I often own the visualization layer end-to-end, from rendering architecture to integration with the application and the NestJS backend. I regularly meet with clients to refine requirements and discuss technical options.
highlights: Built 3D product configurators in Three.js: GLTF/GLB model loading, real-time material and texture swaps, parametric geometry generated from user-entered dimensions.
Implemented scene interactions: raycasting-based element selection, camera control, animations and transitions.
Set up lighting and rendering: HDRI environments, shadows, post-processing.
Optimized scenes for desktop and mobile: instancing, LOD, Draco/KTX2 compression, proper resource disposal.
Export and AR: scene renders to images (e.g. for PDF quotes), 3D model export (GLTFExporter), AR via GLB/USDZ.
Built 2D configurators and editors in PixiJS v8 integrated with React: plan and elevation views, drag & drop, scaling, grid snapping, zoom/pan on large scenes, export to image/PDF.
Connected configurators to business logic: multi-step configuration wizards, passing configurations to ERP/CRM and orders, Stripe payments.
Designed the company-wide admin panel template (React, Mantine, TanStack), adopted in 10+ projects; REST APIs in NestJS with PostgreSQL/TypeORM.
Cross-platform mobile app (Capacitor.js) and reusable Web Components.
I use AI inside the development flow, at planning and implementation: Cursor with MCP, skills and rules (external and my own) for research and execution, while design and review decisions stay mine.
